details: Instead of LCUClient and RiotClientAPI scanning the active process list independently, they now fetch information from client_detector.py which runs a single pass and caches it with a 2-second TTL.

Ported the CustomTkinter UI to PySide6 QMainWindow. Transitioned the old main app to a headless background service coordinator to eliminate redundant Tkinter widget overhead. Added smooth page fade opacity transitions, collapsible sidebars, and thread-safe EventBus status badges.
